items.title: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack
items.summary: Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil's instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended.

items.title: Hot US inflation raises odds of half-point Fed hike in December
items.summary: US inflation came in above forecasts in October, increasing expectations of a bigger rate hike in December and raising concerns for crypto investors.

items.title: Bitcoin slides below $74,000 after hotter-than-expected CPI as analysts warn of drop to $70k
items.summary: BTC slipped under $74,000 after October CPI beat forecasts. Analysts flag $73,000 support and a possible drop toward $69,000.

items.title: Bitcoin Falls as Hot US Inflation Fuels Fears of Bigger Fed Rate Hike
items.summary: Bitcoin fell below $74,000 after October inflation beat forecasts, increasing pressure on the Federal Reserve to raise rates again at its December meeting.

items.title: U.S. CPI rose stronger than expected 0.4% in October; core rate rose 0.3%
items.summary: A December rate hike appears completely assured, with Fed Governor Chris Waller suggesting even a 50-basis-point move could be appropriate.
